what: Thick white-framed cards tilt alternately −4° and +4° and stick one after another 160px from the top of the screen (sticky) as the next card rises and covers the previous one, building a messy stack. On hover the frame turns to the accent color and the photo inside scales to 1.1× in .3s (ease-in-out going in, cubic-bezier(.4,.4,0,1) coming out)

options.--fx-tilt: Tilt (css variable), default 4deg — odd cards are negative
options.--fx-line: Border color on hover (css variable), default var(--kf-accent)
options.--fx-in: Curve when the photo grows (css variable), default ease-in-out — only the 2nd and 3rd cards in the original use cubic-bezier(0.4,0.4,0,1)

……

note: Uses CSS only (sticky). The parent row must be taller than the card to stay stuck — if the text column beside the card group is made sticky, the left title stays along with it like the original
